jobs.description:
Spectross is a business focused on delivering products and services through organized workflows, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

We are seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented **Production Assistant** to support daily production activities, material preparation, quality control, order coordination, and general operational processes.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on work, values accuracy, and works well in a team-oriented environment.

Position Overview

The Production Assistant plays an important role in keeping daily production operations organized, efficient, and on schedule.

This position supports production staff with preparing materials, organizing supplies, tracking work orders, inspecting completed items, and maintaining accurate operational records.

The ideal candidate is reliable, adaptable, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks while following established procedures and quality standards.

Previous production or operations experience is helpful but not required.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist with daily production activities and general operational tasks.
* Prepare, organize, and distribute materials, supplies, and equipment.
* Support production staff with assigned tasks and workflow coordination.
* Review work orders, production instructions, and project requirements.
* Monitor production progress and communicate updates to supervisors.
* Inspect materials and completed products for accuracy, quality, and visible defects.
* Assist with product assembly, finishing, labeling, and packaging when applicable.
* Maintain organized inventory records and track material usage.
* Help prepare completed orders for storage, delivery, or shipment.
* Identify material shortages, production discrepancies, and workflow delays.
* Maintain accurate production records, checklists, and operational documentation.
* Coordinate with production, inventory, purchasing, and operations personnel.
* Keep work areas clean, organized, and compliant with workplace safety procedures.
* Support improvements to production efficiency, organization, and quality.
* Perform additional production and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
* Previous experience in production, manufacturing, packaging, inventory, or warehouse operations is a plus.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office are beneficial.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet established deadlines.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Dependable attendance and a responsible work ethic.
* Willingness to learn new production procedures and equipment.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with team members.
* Commitment to maintaining a safe and organized workplace.

Preferred Experience

Experience in production assistance, materials handling, order preparation, quality inspection, packaging, inventory tracking, or general operations is beneficial.

Candidates with transferable experience and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

Work Environment

This position may involve a combination of production support, material organization, inventory activities, and administrative tasks.

Daily responsibilities require attention to detail, coordination with team members, and the ability to follow established production and safety procedures.

Why Join Spectross?

As a Production Assistant, you will have the opportunity to support important daily operations, develop practical organizational and production skills, and contribute to accurate and efficient workflows.

We value reliability, teamwork, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality.

If you are motivated, organized, and interested in developing your experience in production and operations, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are seeking a talented and driven **Client Account Manager** to join X's world-class team of media professionals, where you will play a pivotal role in building our business with advertisers and their agencies. In this role, you will collaborate with Fortune 500 clients to develop and optimize impactful advertising campaigns, leveraging X's innovative platform to drive results and foster meaningful connections. Ideal candidates are creative, proactive, and passionate about X's mission to become the trusted global digital public square, empowering open discourse and unlimited interactivity through exceptional client relationships.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Collaborate with Fortune 500 advertisers to understand their objectives, recommend best practices, and develop effective, high-impact advertising campaigns.
* Educate and consult clients on how to leverage X's advertising products, sharing best practices to create and execute successful campaigns.
* Execute, optimize, and analyze advertising programs using internal tools and dashboards to maximize performance and results.
* Resolve campaign issues promptly and effectively, identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance efficiency.
* Manage contracts and renewals, supporting the Sales Finance team with payables and collections to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide actionable feedback to product and tools teams to help scale and improve X's advertising platform.
* Mentor new team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture as the organization grows.
* This is an in-person role based in New York City, NY (onsite).

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3+ years of experience managing digital marketing programs for advertisers or their agencies.
* Demonstrated ability to create, develop, and enhance customer relationships, driving trust and collaboration.
* Proven skills in managing large customer relationships, navigating conflicts, and guiding groups to effective business decisions.
* Track record of translating marketing objectives into measurable results, with experience optimizing campaigns by analyzing performance and adjusting key drivers.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to resolving issues.
* Aptitude, creativity, and a preference for working in small, collaborative teams with minimal supervision.
* Strong understanding of the digital marketplace and the competitive landscape in which X operates.
* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) or equivalent relevant experience.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Experience working with Fortune 500 advertisers or agencies in verticals such as retail, technology, or media.
* Familiarity with X's advertising products and the broader social media advertising ecosystem.
* Proven ability to mentor or onboard team members in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to drive campaign optimization and strategic decisions.
* A sense of humor and adaptability to thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven organization.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

$65,000 - $145,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
jobs.description:
About Torch Dental

Torch Dental is a high-growth, venture-backed vertical SaaS company transforming how dental practices run their businesses. Our mission is to give every dental office the modern software, automation, and visibility they need to operate efficiently and profitably.

We are launching our second product in 2026 and will be expanding into the broader practice-operations layers such as Revenue Cycle Management, Finance, HR, payroll, benefits, and back-office workflows—building toward a full dental practice operating system.

Torch Dental is at the Series B stage with strong revenue growth, rapidly expanding products, and a profitable core business. As an RCM Customer Success Manager you’ll play a critical role in shaping the customer experience for our AI-powered revenue cycle management product, partnering closely with dental practices to drive successful adoption, deliver measurable outcomes and help build the foundation for how we scale RCM Customer Success.

About the role

Torch Revenue Cycle Management is Torch Dental's second product: an AI-enabled revenue cycle management platform that helps dental practices. We're launching the product to single practices, multi-location groups and emerging DSOs. We're hiring our first dedicated Customer Success Manager for this product to own the customer relationship end-to-end: from kickoff and payer/PMS setup, through go-live, through ongoing retention and expansion.

What you'll do

* Own onboarding for new RCM customers: lead kickoff calls, and guide practices through going live and continuing to engage with the platform.
* Be the primary point of contact for a growing book of RCM accounts — spanning solo practices, groups, and emerging DSOs — through go-live, steady-state usage, and renewal.
* Be the customer's advocate internally: feed structured feedback to Product and Engineering on integration issues, payer coverage gaps, and workflow pain points, and to Sales on expansion and DSO opportunities.
* Help build the playbook: since this is a new, high-touch, fast-scaling function, you'll help define onboarding scripts, health-score criteria, and escalation processes as much as execute them.
* Partner closely with the RCM sales, product, and billing-ops team during the handoff from sales-closed to customer-live, and take that ownership off their plates.
* Handle the compliance-sensitive parts of onboarding correctly — BAAs, PMS credentials, payer portal access — in a HIPAA-aware way.

What we're looking for

**Required:**

* 3–5+ years in a customer success, account management, or implementation role, ideally in a startup or fast-scaling SaaS environment.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: this is a first-of-its-kind role at Torch, without an existing playbook, on a product that is itself still early and evolving.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be explaining claims and billing concepts to dental office staff and translating customer workflows back to engineering and product.
* Strong tech competency - you will be working directly with customers on integrating several solutions and will need to do basic tech implementation. You should feel comfortable with tech and learning new solutions.
* Process-builder mindset: comfortable creating and iterating on onboarding scripts, health-score frameworks, and escalation paths rather than inheriting a mature one.
* Familiarity with dental practice management systems (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, or similar) is a strong plus; comfort learning new PMS and payer systems quickly is required.

**Nice to have:**

* Background as a dental or medical biller, RCM specialist, or practice manager.
* Direct, hands-on experience with dental or medical billing / revenue cycle workflows — you know what an EOB, ERA, clearinghouse, and payer portal are, and ideally have touched claims submission or payment posting yourself.
* Experience supporting healthcare or dental customers through a HIPAA-regulated onboarding process (BAAs, PHI handling).
* Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM for account and health tracking.
* Experience working with DSOs (dental support organizations) or multi-location group practices.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative**

Location: New York City | In-office

**The Mission**
===============

*“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”*

Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems.

Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people.

**The Opportunity to Start Customer Conversations**
===================================================

As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll help specialty clinics and healthcare groups take the first step toward working with Taxo. You’ll own prospect research, outreach, initial qualification, and meeting scheduling for assigned accounts and leads. Your work will create well-qualified sales conversations, with clear context for the colleague taking each opportunity through evaluation and closing.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* **Research the Right Accounts:** Identify clinics and healthcare groups that fit our target customer profile. Find relevant contacts, understand their operations, and keep account information accurate.
* **Start Useful Conversations:** Reach prospects through thoughtful calls, email, and professional networks. Follow up on assigned inbound, event, and partner leads with messages that connect Taxo’s capabilities to a relevant operational need.
* **Qualify Interest and Fit:** Learn about the prospect’s workflow, pain points, relevant stakeholders, and timing. Apply agreed qualification criteria and distinguish a real opportunity from interest that needs more time.
* **Book Meetings and Make Clear Handoffs:** Schedule qualified discovery meetings, confirm attendance, and share concise notes on the prospect’s needs, context, and next steps. Coordinate with the receiving seller so the customer does not have to start over.
* **Keep Outreach Organized:** Maintain reliable CRM records, follow-up tasks, and account ownership. Respect contact preferences and handle information carefully in a healthcare environment.
* **Improve the Outreach Process:** Test messages and sequences, share objections and customer feedback, and track responses, meetings held, accepted opportunities, and the quality of sourced pipeline. Use coaching and results to improve your approach.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **The Early Sales Professional:** 6+ months in sales, business development, or customer-facing work. You’re comfortable initiating conversations and can show how you follow through on goals.
* **The Clear Communicator:** You write concise messages, ask useful questions, listen carefully, and explain a technical product in language a busy healthcare operator can understand.
* **The Organized Prospector:** You can research accounts, manage a queue of outreach and follow-ups, and keep accurate records without losing the personal context behind each conversation.
* **The Curious Learner:** You want to understand clinic operations and how software buying decisions happen. You take feedback well, try new approaches, and stay thoughtful when prospects say no.
* **Bonus:** Experience with a CRM or sales engagement tools, healthcare or B2B software, cold calling, or an early-stage startup.

**Why Taxo**
============

Healthcare teams should be able to spend more time on patients and less time on administration. Help us build the products and company that make that possible.

* **Clear Ownership:** Own the first stage of the customer journey and see how your work contributes to qualified pipeline.
* **Close Collaboration:** Learn from commercial leadership and work closely with the people selling, building, and implementing the product.
* **A Mission with Purpose:** Help healthcare organizations discover a practical way to reduce administrative work.

**Compensation**
================

On-target earnings: $100,000–$110,000 USD annually

Base salary: $60,000–$70,000 USD annually

Equity offered

Benefits: Health coverage

**How We Work**
===============

Taxo is a small, fast, high-conviction team. We care deeply about the problem, move with urgency, and take ownership of the work. We collaborate closely, make practical decisions, and keep improving through what we learn from customers.

If you enjoy starting conversations, learning about customers, and turning curiosity into qualified opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (SNHU Partnership)
jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative (SNHU Partnership)**

You don't pay us. We pay you.

SV Academy is hiring Business Development Representatives through our partnership with Southern New Hampshire University. This is a full-time job that includes free sales training, a 90-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long-term sales role at one of our 400+ partner companies in cities such as Austin, Dallas, San Francisco, Raleigh-Durham, Chicago, Salt Lake City, New York, Tampa Bay, and more.

Cohorts begin every week and are limited to 25 Residents. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

**Compensation**

* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base + 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $55k - $100k in total annual compensation (base + commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.

No tuition. No loans. No deferred-income agreement.

We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT), on Zoom. No cost to you. You'll learn the fundamentals of B2B sales: outbound calls, email and LinkedIn outreach, objection handling, qualification, CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce or HubSpot, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full-time at one of our partner companies as a W-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**

Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full-time tech sales careers and worked with 400+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high-growth verticals.

Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt-free pathways into tech careers.

**Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.**

Who Tends to Succeed Here

No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals
* Comfortable on the phone, including cold calls
* Coachable — you take feedback and act on it
* Resilient — sales involves rejection, and you can keep going
* Strong written and spoken communicators

If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* Apply through this posting — takes about 3 minutes.
* We respond within 2 business days. If you're a fit, we'll set up a 20-minute intro call.
* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.

**Apply today. The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first-reviewed basis.**

 **Requirements**  
  
Required Qualifications:

* English proficiency sufficient for professional work communication
* Permanently authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
* Ability to attend evening sessions during the 2-week bootcamp
* Attendance at one of SNHU's Career Sessions with SV Academy in fall 2026

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Completed Bachelors degree
* Experience in a customer-facing role such as retail, hospitality, customer support, fundraising, or account management
* Experience in a goal-driven role with measurable targets (quotas, KPIs, bookings, revenue, or activity metrics)
* Confident and engaging communicator
* Excited by ambitious goals and motivated by a high-performance environment

  
**Benefits**  

* Comprehensive 2-week online bootcamp training
* Paid 3-month residency with an employer partner
* Exposure to leading technology companies and sales teams
* Professional development and mentorship opportunities
* Supportive community and network of peers

jobs.title: Technical Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The primary purpose of the Technical Sales Representative is to maintain and develop new customers for the sale of Neff products and services within the assigned territory. The incumbent in this position will maintain collaborative relationships with all members of Neff and customers to ensure that the highest degree of service is maintained at all times.

1. Directly reports to Sales Team Leader.

2. This position is non-supervisory.

3. Work and communicate professionally with all staff, customers, and vendors.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Actively calls on existing customers in assigned territory either in person, via e-mail, or via phone.
* Actively seeks out and calls on potential customers by gaining the following information: type of business, size, level of automation, equipment, etc.
* Develops a thorough understanding of customer’s business goals and objectives, operating systems and manufacturing processes.
* Determines business potential for Neff Group products or services.
* Develops accounts for significant business potential customers.
* Team Leader or Sales Manager will assist sales staff to determine what is considered significant business potential.

* Identifies decision-makers for each customer/account. Builds relationships with decision-makers: makes initial contact and introduces Neff Group’s product lines, mission, and develops rapport to identify customer needs.
* Identifies, quantifies and communicates potential cost reductions to decision-makers.
* Identified opportunities to solve existing customer problems and/or enhance customer’s operating systems and processes utilizing Neff Group products and services.
* Is familiar with and makes use of all Neff Group resources to creatively solve problems or enhance effectiveness of customer’s technology.
* Develops and maintains a Customer Contact and Activity Database for assigned accounts. Monitors Sales Activity Reports, projecting annual sales goals, preparing territorial sales forecasts and verifying that sales activity supports the forecast and projected sales.
* Reviews customer activities at least quarterly with Team Leader or Product Sales Manager. Strategizes ways to maximize sales volumes or grow territory.
* Works cooperatively with Inside Sales staff.
* Participates in training and development opportunities as assigned.
* Hold a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive a passenger vehicle without restrictions to meet position requirements.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be engaged off-site making contact with customer’s and working within the assigned sales territory. The employee will also be in an office setting and routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

This position requires frequent travel to customer locations, the incumbent must possess a valid driver’s license. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is primarily in climate controlled settings, but may be exposed to wet and/or humid hot and/or cold conditions, moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, and outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate, ear protection is provided when needed.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* A relevant bachelor's degree in engineering, industrial technology with robotics, and/or sales engineering required.
* In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, a relevant associate degree in a related technical field with strong, demonstrated mechanical/technical aptitude and 3-5 years of technical sales experience.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interprets technical procedures, and product information in English.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

* Ability to mathematical equations to determine quantity, price, discounts, etc.

**REASONING ABILITY**

* Analytical ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Mechanical aptitude and technical ability to engineer solutions and assist with the design of systems to meet customer needs.

**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Computer literacy is strongly preferred.
* Ability to initiate, maintain, and develop relationships.
* Persuasive/closing ability.
* Strong customer focus.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; talk or hear. The employee is required to use hands to touch, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to sit and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Equal Opportunity Employer  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

**Join Related’s Talent Acquisition team in New York as a Recruiting Coordinator!**

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in the full hiring process, from coordinating interviews and delivering an exceptional candidate experience to facilitating onboarding and supporting the day-to-day operations of our recruiting function. You’ll also contribute to the business side of Talent Acquisition, managing vendor relationships, tracking expenses, supporting reporting, and helping keep our processes running efficiently.

If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy balancing multiple priorities while working with people across the business, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how we attract and hire talent at Related.

In this role, you'll play an important part in delivering seamless hiring experience while supporting the day-to-day operations of our recruiting function. You'll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, candidates, and internal business partners to coordinate interviews, manage pre-employment screening, facilitate onboarding, and ensure a smooth transition from candidate to new hire.

Beyond traditional recruiting coordination, this position also supports the business operations of Talent Acquisition, including job board advertising, staffing agency administration, vendor billing, expense tracking, and reporting.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in accuracy, and can balance multiple priorities while providing exceptional service. If you're someone who thrives on organization, enjoys working with people and data, and likes keeping processes running smoothly, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Responsibilties include:

**Recruiting Coordination and Candidate Experience**

* Coordinate interviews, manage scheduling logistics, and communicate with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Provide a welcoming and professional experience for candidates throughout the interview and hiring process.
* Prepare offer letters following internal approvals and monitor offer status through completion.
* Coordinate pre-employment background checks, track outstanding requirements, and communicate updates to recruiters and hiring managers.
* Partner with internal teams, including Legal, to facilitate background screening reviews and resolve outstanding issues.
* Maintain accurate candidate and hiring information in our applicant tracking system (iCIMS).

**New Hire Onboarding**

* Coordinate the onboarding process from offer acceptance through the employee's first day.
* Ensure new hires complete all required employment documents and preboarding requirements.
* Process new hire information through iCIMS and UKG, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Coordinate employment eligibility verification (Form I-9) in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Partner with hiring managers, IT, and training teams to ensure new hires are prepared for their first day.
* Communicate orientation schedules, first-day instructions, and onboarding details to new employees.
* Maintain accurate recruiting records and ensure filled requisitions are properly closed in iCIMS.

**Recruiting Operations and Vendor Management**

* Manage job postings across the company careers website and external job boards, including LinkedIn and Indeed.
* Monitor job board subscriptions, sponsored postings, advertising expenses, and renewal dates.
* Track job advertising performance and assist with evaluating recruiting sources and spending.
* Maintain staffing agency agreements, including placement fees, contract terms, and guarantee periods.
* Coordinate new and renewed staffing agency agreements with internal stakeholders.
* Verify agency candidate submissions and assist with resolving vendor-related questions.

**Billing, Reporting, and Administrative Support**

* Review, reconcile, and process recruiting-related invoices, including staffing agency fees, job board advertising, and other vendor expenses.
* Verify invoice accuracy and allocate expenses to the appropriate property, market, or cost center.
* Identify billing discrepancies and work with vendors to resolve issues.
* Maintain accurate records of recruiting expenses and support monthly billing and budget tracking.
* Prepare recruiting reports and analyze hiring activity, recruiting expenses, and vendor performance.
* Use Excel to organize data, reconcile information, and develop reports that support recruiting operations.

jobs.description:
Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at PowerPlan, you will manage the relationship of a portfolio of energy and utility customers, serving as their trusted advisor from renewal to expansion. You will partner with Sales and the extended account team to help each customer get measurable ROI from their PowerPlan solutions, working proactively to keep your accounts healthy, surface opportunities and address risk before it becomes churn, and grow ARR year over year.

You will work at every level of a customer's organization, building trusted relationships and staying connected across the account, including leading quarterly business reviews to senior leadership. This is a relationship-driven, customer-facing role where retention, advocacy, and growth are yours to drive.

PowerPlan is the leading tax and accounting software for asset-intensive businesses, improving financial outcomes through AI-powered technology that enables companies to overcome their most complex financial challenges. Our enterprise-grade tax, accounting, reporting, and workflow automation software serves the office of the CFO at some of the world's largest asset-intensive companies, helping them generate more cashflow, mitigate compliance risk, and build a culture of cost management.

Our Customer Success organization is where that promise is kept after the sale: the team that turns PowerPlan's capabilities into renewals, references, and long-term value for our customers.

Responsibilities:

* Own the renewal and forecast outcome for your assigned book of business, understanding each account's contractual terms, pricing strategy, and services history to track ARR, churn risk, and bringing accurate status into the monthly Renewal and Risk Meeting.
* Become a trusted advisor by building multithreaded relationships across each account, removing roadblocks and demonstrating a clear return on their PowerPlan investment.
* Build industry acumen in Energy, Utilities, and other asset-intensive industries, and maintain functional knowledge of the PowerPlan solution, understanding what drives customer success, speaking credibly to product capabilities, and knowing each customer's product footprint and usage, so you can anticipate needs and guide accounts toward the outcomes that matter most to them.
* Maintain strong customer sentiment and account engagement through proactive relationship management, accurate health scoring in Salesforce and Planhat, early risk identification, and save plans that drive net-positive red-to-green movement each quarter.
* Lead standardized Quarterly Business Reviews that connect PowerPlan capabilities to customer business objectives, demonstrate value through utilization and outcome metrics, identify opportunities to increase adoption, and align on desired outcomes, agreed-upon next steps, and a path to long-term value realization.
* Manage the NPS survey for your customers, driving survey participation, closing the loop on feedback with each respondent, and helping the team reach its best-in-class score and response-rate targets.
* Represent the voice of the customer, translating feedback, business needs, and product usage trends into actionable insights for Product and Marketing to improve customer outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to year-over-year growth by identifying expansion opportunities, generating qualified leads for Sales, and developing referenceable customers.
* Advocate for your customer needs cross-functionally, coordinating with Sales, Support and Professional Services to resolve escalations, define action plans and achieve account objectives.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Account Management, Enterprise Software, SaaS, Professional Services, or a related field.
* Proven success managing a portfolio of customer relationships with accountability for customer retention, renewal outcomes, adoption, and growth opportunities.
* Experience building trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders at every level, from senior leadership to day-to-day users.
* Experience using Salesforce, Gainsight, Planhat, or a comparable Customer Success platform strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and proactively drive customer outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and meeting facilitation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels within customer organizations and internally across cross-functional teams.
* Experience leading customer business reviews, developing success plans, and driving customer engagement initiatives that deliver measurable business value.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate complex customer environments, and coordinate efforts across Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support, and other internal teams.
* Familiarity with AI-driven technologies and customer-facing software solutions is a plus, as PowerPlan continues to expand AI-powered capabilities across the NXT SaaS platform.
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and energized by working both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Willingness to travel to support customer engagements, business reviews, onsite meetings, and strategic account planning.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

**PowerPlan is an EOE**

Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
MessageGears is the first and only customer marketing platform that connects directly to our customers' enterprise data warehouse. By combining the power and security of on-premises software with the efficiency and scalability of cloud delivery, we enable marketers to capitalize on every message opportunity. We're disrupting an industry by providing a solution that gives marketers complete control over their multi-channel programs through advanced technology. Our product is solving marketing challenges for Enterprise customers that undoubtedly reach every candidate applying for this position.

**Position Objective**

This is not your typical CSM position. Are you a technical relationship builder who thrives on deconstructing complex workflows and proving the ROI of sophisticated software? At MessageGears, we don’t need coordinators; we need strategic partners.

As a Customer Success Manager, you will manage a focused, high-impact book of 10–15 enterprise accounts. Because our platform sits at the heart of our customers' data ecosystems, this role requires more than just "checking in." You will be expected to deeply understand the technical nuances of how your customers leverage our platform to drive their engagement strategies.

Why this role is different:

* **Technical Depth:** You’ll go beyond the surface level, truly understanding the "how" and "why" behind customer implementations to ensure they are maximizing the platform’s power.
* **Enterprise Focus:** You won’t be spread thin. With a small, elite book of business, you have the space to become an extension of your customers’ teams.
* **Strategic Ownership:** You are the primary architect of account health, renewals, and expansion. You don’t just relay messages to Support and Product—you collaborate with them as an expert on your customer’s technical needs.

This is the ideal role for a high-performance professional who is energized by technical complexity and wants to move away from high-volume account management toward deep, enterprise-level impact.

**What you'll do**

* **Account Ownership:** Serve as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of enterprise MessageGears customers; maintain strong relationships across customer organizations and ensure customers are consistently achieving value from the platform.
* **Cross-Functional Project Leadership:** Act as the primary driver for a diverse range of initiatives, from high-stakes customer migrations and technical platform expansions to internal process optimizations. You must be able to define project scope, build strategic plans, and lead stakeholders through complex business transitions without losing sight of the end goal.
* **AI-Assisted Customer Management:** Use AI-powered tools for QBR preparation, customer health analysis, and meeting note synthesis; develop strong judgment to validate AI-generated insights against first-hand customer knowledge before driving decisions or communications.
* **Adoption & Value Realization:** Monitor platform adoption and usage health across your accounts; proactively engage customers to drive adoption of underutilized features, share best practices, and ensure customers are capturing the full value of MessageGears.
* **Renewal Management:** Own the renewal process for accounts in your portfolio; identify renewal risk early, develop mitigation plans, and partner with Sales on renewal strategy and negotiation.
* **Expansion Identification:** Identify and qualify expansion opportunities within your book of business; partner with Sales to develop account expansion strategies and support commercial conversations.
* **Business Reviews:** Prepare and lead quarterly business reviews with enterprise customers; present platform performance data, business impact, and forward-looking roadmap to customer stakeholders.
* **Issue Resolution & Escalation:** Manage customer issues and escalations within your portfolio; partner with Support, Product, and Solutions Engineering to drive resolution and communicate proactively with customers throughout.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Capture and communicate customer feedback, feature requests, and product needs to Product and Engineering; ensure the customer perspective is represented in internal planning.

**Qualifications**

* **Customer Success Experience:** 3+ years in customer success, account management, or a related post-sale role at a B2B SaaS company; experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
* **Preferred Background:** Experience with marketing technology, data platforms, or enterprise software customer success is a meaningful asset.
* **AI CS Tools:** Experience using AI tools for QBR preparation, health scoring, and customer communication drafting; ability to critically evaluate AI-generated insights before applying them to account decisions. Adheres to MessageGears' data security policy.
* **Enterprise Relationship Management:** Strong ability to manage multi-stakeholder customer relationships; comfortable engaging from end users through executive level.
* **Data-Driven Account Management:** Able to use customer health and usage data to drive proactive account interventions; comfortable working with dashboards, health scores, and customer analytics tools.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication; able to prepare compelling business reviews, executive summaries, and customer-facing documentation.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Effective at coordinating across Support, Sales, Product, and Solutions Engineering to resolve customer issues and drive account outcomes.

jobs.title: Retirement Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Gusto**

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role:**

The Conversion Specialist manages the onboarding experience for 401(k) plans transferring an existing plan to the Gusto 401k platform. This role oversees the full conversion lifecycle — from initial handoff through asset transfer, data reconciliation, and first contribution — ensuring accurate recordkeeping and a smooth transition for plan sponsors and administrators. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of retirement plan mechanics, meticulous attention to detail, and the confidence to guide employers through a complex, multi-step process. They work exclusively with plan sponsors and administrators and partner closely with Legal, Sales, and Operations to keep conversions on track and compliant.

**About the Team:**

The Conversion Onboarding team handles one of the most operationally complex moments in a client's journey: moving an existing retirement plan to a new provider. We combine operational rigor with a client-first approach, ensuring sponsors and administrators feel supported and informed at every step — and that assets are transferred accurately and on time.

**Here's what you'll do day-to-day:**

* Manage a dedicated book of business of 401(k) plan conversions from signing through completed asset transfer and first contribution
* Work with plan sponsors and administrators to gather required documentation and ensure accurate data is submitted to support a smooth asset transfer and recordkeeping transition
* Serve as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors and administrators via email, phone, and video — including inbound scheduling through Calendly
* Guide employers through pre-ready task dashboards, proactively preventing stalls and keeping plans on track for their plan start date
* Monitor and drive performance against key benchmarks including time to activation, time to ready, CSAT, and average response time
* Partner closely with Operations and cross-functional teams including Sales and Legal to support asset transfers, client expectations, and complex plan changes
* Use AI tools to streamline workflows, improve client communications, and increase efficiency across your book of business

**Here's what we're looking for:**

* 2+ years of total work experience with 1+ years in client-facing implementation, technical account management, or retirement plan administration; startup and/or financial services experience a plus
* Proven ability to manage a large, active book of business involving complex, multi-step processes simultaneously
* Deep knowledge in one or more of the following: SaaS, Operations, or Finance; retirement plan experience strongly preferred
* Strong analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail, particularly around data accuracy and reconciliation
* Proficiency with Salesforce and comfort working across case management and collaboration tools in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication skills across email, phone, and video with a client-first mindset
* RPS or CRPS designation a plus, or active pursuit of either; familiarity with ERISA requirements, payroll systems, bundled vs. unbundled providers, or Safe Harbor compliance is a plus.

Our cash compensation range for this role is $53,750.00/year to 64,500.00/year in Denver and Atlanta. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

**Reliable, consistent presence:** We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deser

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative (Atlanta)
jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

The Field Service Representative (FSR) is a frontline, relationship-driven role responsible for expanding the referral footprint by building trusted partnerships with primary care providers, pediatricians, OB/GYNs, internal medicine practices, and key community stakeholders. This role is not transactional sales. It is a consultative, educational field position focused on helping referring practices understand when and how to refer, simplifying referral workflows, and driving consistent, qualified patient referrals into clinics.

The FSR is accountable for referral growth, conversion, and repeat referral behavior within their assigned territory.

This role supports referral development, patient access, and clinic operations in alignment with Geode Health’s mission to transform mental healthcare by making it more accessible, affordable, and effective.

This representative would support offices in Midtown Atlanta, Fayetteville, Columbus & Savannah.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in healthcare sales, medical referral development, or field-based B2B roles
* Proven ability to build relationships and influence clinical and non-clinical stakeholders
* Strong communication, organization, and follow-through skills
* Comfort working independently in a field-based role with performance accountability
* Resilience and persistence—comfortable hearing “no” and navigating access barriers
* Experience in behavioral health, mental health, CNS, home health, hospice, or specialty care (preferred)
* Prior pharmaceutical, device, or healthcare services sales experience (preferred)
* Familiarity with CRM systems and territory-based sales models (preferred)

**Responsibilities**

* Build and sustain strong referral relationships with PCPs, pediatricians, OB/GYNs, internal medicine practices, and practice managers
* Educate physicians and office staff on when to refer, the care model, and referral pathways
* Serve as the primary field liaison representing clinical value, access model, and outcomes
* Own and manage a defined territory using an A/B/C account strategy
* Execute a disciplined call cadence with clear visit objectives
* Conduct pre-call planning and practice profiling (decision-makers, referral workflows, insurance mix)
* Navigate gatekeepers and secure meaningful access to decision-makers
* Simplify referral processes and reduce friction in scheduling and communication
* Introduce referral tools and materials that enable seamless patient handoffs
* Partner with intake, operations, and clinic teams to ensure a smooth referral-to-appointment experience
* Accurately document field activity, referrals, and follow-ups in CRM
* Track referral to appointment to treatment start conversion
* Use data and insights to prioritize accounts and improve performance
* Conduct in-office education sessions, staff meetings, and lunch-and-learns
* Represent the organization professionally at local events and community touchpoints as appropriate
* Complete all other relevant responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor

**Values & Professional Expectations**

The Field Service Representative is expected to demonstrate Geode Health’s values through daily work behaviors and interactions, including:

* **Accountability:** Taking ownership of territory management, referral relationships, performance outcomes, and follow-through on commitments
* **Integrity:** Representing services, referral pathways, and access expectations accurately while maintaining confidentiality and compliance
* **One Team:** Working collaboratively with intake, clinic, operations, and field colleagues to support consistent patient access and referral coordination
* **Balance:** Managing field responsibilities responsibly and communicating workload needs appropriately to support sustainable performance
* **Continuous Improvement:** Using data, feedback, and coaching to refine outreach strategy and improve referral quality and conversion
* **Servant Leadership:** Supporting referring partners, clinic teams, and patients with professionalism, respect, and a service-oriented mindset

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant healthcare field or referral development experience

**Required Licensure / Certifications**

* None required

**Estimated earnings****:**

$65,000.00-$100,000.00

**Position Summary:**

The Project Coordinator/Prevention Facilitator is responsible for coordinating and implementing all activities associated with the Drug-Free Communities (DFC) Coalition. This position provides leadership for coalition development, youth engagement, prevention programming, community outreach, data collection, evaluation activities, public awareness campaigns, and stakeholder collaboration. The Project Coordinator serves as the primary facilitator of prevention initiatives designed to reduce youth alcohol and cannabis use while increasing protective factors among youth and families.

This position collaborates with schools, community organizations, youth leaders, coalition members, and evaluation staff to implement evidence-based prevention strategies consistent with the Drug-Free Communities Support Program.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Coordinate monthly coalition meetings and committee meetings.

* Recruit and retain coalition members representing the twelve required DFC sectors.
* Maintain coalition membership records and participation documentation.
* Conduct onboarding and orientation for new coalition members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of coalition strategic plans and action plans.
* Facilitate communication among coalition partners and community stakeholders.
* Recruit and support Youth Advisory Council members.
* Facilitate Youth Advisory Council meetings.

* Engage youth in prevention messaging, campaign development, and community activities.
* Support youth-led prevention and advocacy initiatives.
* Coordinate and facilitate community prevention activities, including but not limited to: Red Ribbon Week, Youth Summits, Sticker Shock Campaigns, health fairs, parent education events, community outreach events, Safe Festival initiatives.
* Coordinate guest speakers and community presentations.
* Develop prevention messaging focused on youth alcohol and cannabis prevention.
* Develop and distribute prevention-focused social media content.
* Support production of public service announcements and prevention awareness campaigns.
* Assist with media outreach and community awareness activities.
* Promote coalition initiatives through digital and community communication platforms.
* Administer youth surveys and prevention outcome assessments.
* Assist in collecting and maintaining program performance data.
* Collaborate with the program evaluator in data collection and reporting activities.
* Maintain required logs, attendance records, and outcome data.
* Assist in the preparation of quarterly, annual, and grant-required reports.
* Support continuous quality improvement efforts.
* Develop and disseminate prevention resource guides.
* Provide referrals to prevention, treatment, behavioral health, and community support services.
* Maintain current knowledge of local prevention and treatment resources.
* Ensure compliance with CDC Drug-Free Communities grant requirements.
* Maintain documentation necessary for grant monitoring and reporting.
* Assist program leadership in completing required federal reports and continuation applications.
* Participate in required DFC and National Coalition Institute training.
* Ensure that a comprehensive education program is offered to all youth clients, including the use of appropriate up-to-date curriculum, videos, assignments, and guest speakers.

* Improve the health, welfare, and well-being of at-risk youth by providing a daily schedule of educational and therapeutic activities. This includes early education of misuse/use/abuse of substances, physical and psychological effects, health-related concerns, and appropriate use of leisure time skills.
* Advocate for informed choices by providing resources and referrals for continued care.
* Provide community education on the Youth Services continuum of service delivery options.
* Document in case files all attendance in groups and pertinent data collected relevant to treatment goals.
* Report all concerns to the program manager for any follow-up that may be needed.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to President / Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Chicago and surrounding suburbs (currently Buffalo Grove)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, with occasional evenings or weekends as business needs require  
**Reports To:** President / Owner  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience

About the Position

We are seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant to work directly with the President and Owner of a diverse portfolio of businesses in the Chicago area.

Our businesses span the restaurant, bakery, retail, hospitality, entertainment, and consulting industries.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with an entrepreneur overseeing multiple growing companies, including Hello Kitty Café Chicago, Hello Tokyo, Good Fortune Baking, and other hospitality and retail ventures.

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment, takes initiative, solves problems independently, and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**This is not a traditional administrative assistant position.** We are looking for a trusted right-hand person who can help coordinate day-to-day business activities, oversee follow-ups, manage special projects, and ensure that important responsibilities are completed efficiently.

Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive & Personal Assistance

* Manage the President's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule.
* Organize and prioritize emails, correspondence, and communications.
* Coordinate business and personal travel arrangements.
* Prepare documents, presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and correspondence.
* Maintain confidential business and personal records.
* Assist with personal appointments, errands, and logistical arrangements as needed.

Business Operations Coordination

* Serve as a central point of communication between the President, managers, employees, vendors, and business partners.
* Follow up with management teams regarding assigned tasks, deadlines, and operational issues.
* Track outstanding projects and ensure timely completion.
* Help identify operational problems and coordinate solutions.
* Assist with employee onboarding, scheduling coordination, and administrative HR matters.
* Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants, attorneys, and outside consultants.
* Visit business locations as necessary to check on projects and report progress.

Vendor & Project Management

* Communicate with suppliers, contractors, landlords, and service providers.
* Request quotes, compare pricing, and coordinate purchasing.
* Track vendor orders, deliveries, invoices, and outstanding issues.
* Coordinate maintenance, repairs, installations, and renovations.
* Manage project timelines and provide regular progress updates.
* Research products, services, and business opportunities.

Financial & Administrative Support

* Organize invoices, receipts, contracts, and financial documents.
* Monitor upcoming payments, renewals, and administrative deadlines.
* Assist with expense tracking, invoice verification, and basic reporting.
* Prepare business performance summaries using information from managers and existing systems.
* Coordinate with bookkeeping and accounting teams.
* Maintain organized digital files and records across multiple companies.

Marketing & Special Projects

* Assist with coordinating marketing initiatives, promotions, and special events.
* Communicate with marketing agencies, designers, and outside partners.
* Help organize private events, business meetings, and promotional activities.
* Research new business concepts, potential vendors, and expansion opportunities.
* Support new business openings and other special projects assigned by the President.

Qualifications

* Minimum 3 years of experience in executive assistance, business administration, operations coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience supporting a business owner, entrepreneur, or senior executive strongly preferred.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple companies, projects, and competing deadlines.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and independent judgment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and modern business software.
* Comfortable learning new technology, including AI productivity tools.
* High level of discretion, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel between Chicago-area business locations.
* Hospitality, restaurant, or retail experience is a plus, but not required.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* **Takes ownership:** Doesn't wait to be told every step and follows tasks through to completion.
* **Is exceptionally organized:** Keeps track of deadlines, responsibilities, and details across multiple businesses.
* **Is resourceful:** Can research problems, identify solutions, and present recommendations.
* **Communicates effectively:** Provides concise updates and knows when an issue requires the President's attention.
* **Is adaptable:** Comfortable switching between executive support, business operations, and personal assistance.
* **Is trustworthy:** Handles confidential business, financial, and personal matters with discretion.
* **Gets things done:** Focuses on execution, accountability, and results.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will have established an organized system for managing the President's schedule, communications, business priorities, and outstanding projects.

The candidate will independently coordinate routine administrative matters, follow up with management teams, and provide clear daily updates on priorities and unresolved issues.

Our goal is to find someone who can grow with the organization and become a long-term, trusted member of the executive team.

**To Apply:** Please submit your résumé and a brief description of your experience

Welcome to **The DRIPBaR Chicago West Loop**, where proactive wellness, innovation, and personalized care come together.

Our new Chicago West Loop location is being developed as an elevated wellness destination where exceptional client experiences, innovative services, and a commitment to well-being come together.

Once open, you will collaborate with our Lead Nurse and wellness team to coordinate daily nonclinical operations, elevate the client experience, support membership growth, and help drive business performance.

* Build relationships with prospective clients and develop opportunities for future memberships and appointments.

* Coordinate daily nonclinical operations, client scheduling, and front desk activities.

* **We welcome experienced wellness professionals, Registered Nurses (RNs), Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs), and healthcare professionals interested in transitioning into wellness operations, business development, and leadership.**

jobs.description:
**About Pocas International Corp.**

At Pocas International Corp., we are a passionate importer and distributor focused on bringing unique, high-quality specialty products from around the world to customers and partners throughout the United States and beyond.

Since 2005, we have built strong, long-term relationships with distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and business partners by offering exceptional products and service with honesty, integrity, and consistency.

As part of our continued business expansion, we are also growing our K-beauty, cosmetics, and related lifestyle product lines alongside our established food & beverage business, working across a multi-branch network in New Jersey, California, Illinois, Texas, Georgia, and Florida.

Kindly visit www.pocas.com for details!

**Position Summary**

Pocas International Corp. is seeking a **B2B Sales Representative** to grow and manage accounts across our wholesale and retail distribution network. This is a field-first, business-to-business sales role — the successful candidate will spend the majority of their time visiting existing customers to maintain and grow the relationship, and cold calling/prospecting new accounts within the assigned territory.

Primary target channels include Beauty Supply stores, Beauty & Health wholesalers, general wholesale distributors, chain supermarkets, retail chains, and independent markets. Experience selling into the Beauty Supply channel or Beauty-related B2B accounts is strongly preferred, but candidates with strong B2B wholesale/retail sales experience in any consumer product category are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

Present new products, promotions, and pricing programs to existing buyers and store owners.

Resolve account-level issues (order concerns, delivery timing, pricing questions) by coordinating with internal Operations and Customer Service teams.

Maintain a consistent visit cadence and account history for each assigned customer.

**New Business Development / Cold Calling**

Prospect and generate new accounts through outbound cold calling, in-person cold visits, trade shows, and industry events.

Identify and prioritize target accounts among Beauty Supply stores, Beauty & Health wholesalers, wholesale distributors, chain supermarkets, retail chains, and independent markets.

Present product lines, pricing, and promotional programs directly to buyers and decision-makers.

Negotiate initial orders, pricing, and promotional placement within company-approved guidelines.

Represent the company at trade shows and industry events to build the account pipeline.

**Reporting & Cross-Functional Coordination**

Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, visit log, and account records using CRM or reporting tools.

Communicate order details and customer requirements to the internal operations/customer service team for processing — this role is not responsible for order fulfillment or inventory coordination.

Gather and share competitive intelligence, customer feedback, and market trends observed in the field with Sales, Purchasing, and Marketing.

Coordinate with branch teams via Microsoft Teams on account status, delivery timing, and customer needs.

**Qualifications**

Experience in B2B, wholesale, or retail account sales, with a track record of both managing existing accounts and developing new business through cold calling/prospecting.

Willingness and ability to travel regularly within the assigned territory to visit customers in person.

Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Strong in-person relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Comfortable making outbound cold calls and initiating contact with new prospective accounts.

Self-motivated and able to work independently in the field with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Strong follow-up discipline and accurate CRM/record-keeping habits.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience selling into the **Beauty Supply** channel, or other **Beauty & Health B2B** wholesale accounts.

Existing relationships with Beauty Supply stores, beauty/health wholesalers, chain supermarkets, retail chains, or independent markets.

Direct experience with K-beauty, cosmetics, skincare, or beauty and personal-care products.

Familiarity with beauty trends, product positioning, competitor research, and customer buying behavior.

Bilingual proficiency (English plus Spanish or Korean) is a plus, but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**

Existing accounts are retained and grown, with a reliable, professional visit cadence.

New account acquisition through cold calling and prospecting is consistent and on pace with territory goals.

The sales pipeline and account records are accurate and up to date.

Field feedback and market trends are captured and shared to support the broader business.

**Why Join Us**

Sell across an expanding portfolio spanning food & beverage and K-beauty/cosmetics into established Beauty Supply, wholesale, and retail channels.

Own your territory and customer relationships with significant day-to-day autonomy.

Focus on what you do best — selling — without being pulled into internal operations work.

Be part of a multicultural company with an established U.S. distribution network across NJ, CA, IL, TX, GA, and FL.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Health insurance, subject to applicable plan terms.

Paid time off, in accordance with company policy.

Paid Holidays, in accordance with company policy.

Eligibility for company-sponsored pensions (Profit Sharing Plan and Cash Balance Plan) benefit programs, subject to plan terms and eligibility r

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Endeavor is real-world enterprise AI.

AI models are improving faster than most companies can put them to work. Endeavor closes that gap.

We exist to secure American industrial leadership. AI is the largest advantage available to the companies that make, move, and defend things in this country, and most of them can't reach it alone. We close that distance — so their customers pay less, their people do work worth doing, and the companies themselves come out stronger than the competition abroad.

To do that, we build custom AI systems for companies in mission-critical industries — manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, defense, life sciences. Not software they rent from a vendor that doesn't understand their business. Systems they own, built inside their own stack, in production in weeks.

Operating Principles

* One team, one fight. Small companies fail for a hundred reasons. Being internally misaligned shouldn't be one of them. We think like owners of the whole business — the question is always how *we* win. We're fighting the world, not each other.
* Strong convictions, loosely held. Show up with a point of view and hold that view loosely enough that better evidence can move it. The best ideas come from candor and debate.
* Default to open. Our clients trust us with their hardest problems and we extend that same trust internally. Information here is open by default — data, context, the reasoning behind decisions — because you can't own an outcome you can only see half of.

The Role | Business Development Representative

As a Business Development Representative, you will identify and qualify new business opportunities, generate leads, and build relationships with potential clients. You will collaborate closely with the sales team to develop strategies, set up meetings, and ensure successful handoffs of qualified leads for closing. Your role will require consistent communication, client outreach, and an ability to effectively present and tailor solutions to fit client needs.

What We Require

* Genuine curiosity about the customer. You research the market, form a point of view, and bring it to the call instead of reciting a script.
* Comfort with a half-built playbook. Ours isn't finished. You'd rather help write it than wait for it, and you can move with 70% of the information and correct as you learn.
* Self-direction. You set your own pace, flag what's working and what isn't, and ask for help early instead of quietly stalling.
* A teammate people want on their accounts. You share what's working, take direct feedback without getting defensive, and make the AEs and marketers around you better.
