new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

At Overhill Dental, every smile has a story. We provide comprehensive and cosmetic dental care centered on health, confidence, and an exceptional patient experience. We are looking for a dependable, resourceful individual who enjoys connecting with people and helping them move confidently through their care.

You will coordinate the patient journey from the first inquiry through treatment scheduling, payment, and follow-up. This role combines patient service, treatment coordination, and front office administration. You will work closely with the dentist and clinical team to keep patients informed, schedules productive, and administrative details accurate.

**Duties:**

**Treatment coordination and follow through**

* Review dentist-approved treatment plans with patients, explaining proposed appointments, fees, estimated insurance benefits (if applicable), and expected patient responsibility in understandable terms.
* Reinforce information provided by the clinical team and refer questions about diagnosis, necessity, risks, alternatives, or prognosis to the treating clinician.
* Discuss financial concerns respectfully, explain approved payment and financing options, and assist with applications without promising approval.
* Schedule recommended care in the sequence and appointment lengths directed by the clinical team; coordinate referrals when needed.
* Maintain an organized follow-up list for unscheduled treatment, pending financial arrangements, and patients who need additional information; document contacts and outcomes.
* Support informed patient decisions without pressure, guarantees of clinical results, or representations that insurance estimates are guaranteed.

**Patient experience and communication**

* Welcome patients warmly, manage check-in and checkout, and create a professional, organized front office.
* Respond promptly to calls, texts, emails, and new patient inquiries; document conversations and follow through on next steps.
* Coordinate onboarding, digital forms, confirmations, and appointment preparation; identify missing information before visits.
* Listen to patient concerns, resolve routine service issues, and escalate clinical questions, complaints, or exceptions appropriately.

**Scheduling and financial administration**

* Manage the dentist and hygiene schedules using approved appointment templates, treatment priorities, and provider availability.
* Monitor cancellations, openings, and waitlists; offer appropriate appointments and coordinate changes with the clinical team.
* Coordinate recall and reactivation outreach to help established patients maintain ongoing care.
* Prepare written financial estimates and agreements, communicate payment expectations before appointments, and collect required payment before treatment in accordance with practice policy.
* Process payments accurately, issue receipts, post transactions, and reconcile daily collections with practice records.
* Review patient balances, follow up on amounts due, and escalate disputed charges, refunds, discounts, or adjustments for authorization.
* Verify insurance eligibility and available benefits before visits; obtain necessary information and clearly distinguish estimates from confirmed payments.
* Support claim preparation, submission, tracking, and follow-up as assigned; coordinate unresolved insurance issues with the designated billing lead or practice leadership.

**Office systems and team coordination**

* Maintain accurate patient demographics, communication notes, financial records, and administrative documentation in the practice management system.
* Learn and use Practice Management Software and other approved tools for scheduling, communication, insurance workflows, and patient payments.
* Participate in daily team huddles, flag scheduling or financial concerns, and provide clear handoffs between the front office and clinical team.
* Protect confidential patient and financial information and follow practice privacy, security, and HIPAA procedures.
* Monitor assigned office supplies and reorder within approved budgets and purchasing authority.
* Identify recurring workflow problems, recommend practical improvements, and maintain checklists that make daily work more reliable.
* Support related front office duties as practice needs evolve, with priorities set by leadership.

**Who will succeed here**

You are warm with patients and precise with details. You can discuss money calmly, manage competing priorities, and close the loop on commitments. You ask thoughtful questions, learn unfamiliar systems, and take initiative while recognizing when a decision requires clinical or leadership approval.

* Exceptional patient service and professional verbal and written communication.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, accurate data entry, and comfort working with numbers.
* Resourcefulness, sound judgment, problem-solving, and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to discuss treatment costs and payment expectations with empathy and confidence.
* Dependability, accountability, coachability, and a collaborative approach.
* Comfort with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and learning new software.

**Our culture and how to apply**

We value kindness, professionalism, curiosity, and accountability. We want someone who takes pride in helping patients and enjoys contributing to a growing practice. In return, we offer a collaborative environment, opportunities to learn, and a meaningful role in how our practice serves its community.

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction describing your relevant experience, your comfort discussing treatment costs and payments, and why this role interests you.

new_jobs.title: Associate Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **Our Mission**

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

### **Our Values**

* **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
* **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
* **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
* **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
* **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
* **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

We're looking for a chronically online Associate Social Media Manager who moves at the speed of social. You know what stops the scroll, what feels native vs. forced, and how to turn an idea into something people actually want to watch and share. If you live in the comment sections, follow reality TV drama like a sport, know what’s trending before it hits the mainstream, and get Virgo-level obsessed about data and content calendars, this is the role for you.

You'll support the Social Content Lead and Senior Social Director in managing the content calendar, creating and optimizing content across TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, and owning day-to-day community management from the caption to the comment section.

### **Where You'll Work:**

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week in Los Angeles, CA.

  

### **In This Role, You Will:**

***Support and create strategic content execution and social media campaigns***

* Build and manage day-to-day posting calendars
* Create and optimize social-first content for TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms, including supporting with hands-on graphic design and video editing
* Support social campaign development, including research, briefs, and creative strategy
* Move a post from a raw idea to a published asset — including copywriting, asset creation, approvals, and scheduling
* Write engaging captions, Threads, and tweets
* Schedule, tag, and publish posts for content optimization and reporting

***Own community management***

* Reply to comments and direct messages in the brand's voice
* Monitor brand mentions and sentiment across platforms
* Foster fan relationships and surface earned moments
* Source and manage UGC opportunities across platforms
* Escalate sensitive comments, DMs, or sentiment shifts according to team guidelines
* Surface insights from comments, DMs, and cultural shifts
* Help the broader team understand what's actually resonating (or not)

***Track performance for insights-to-action***

* Pull analytics reports across platforms
* Track engagement, reach, and follower growth
* Apply insights to action — feed learnings back into the content daily

***Trend watching***

* Spot internet culture shifts, viral trends and formats, emerging platforms, and competitor moves
* Surface potential risks, controversies, and emerging narratives taking place on internet communities
* Identify up-and-coming creators and talent for owned social campaigns

### **Skills Required:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on social media marketing experience
* Strong understanding of scheduling and listening software (i.e. Dash Social)
* Ability to concept, shoot, design, edit, and publish thumb-stopping social content; video editing and graphic design experience required.
* Comfortable behind or in-front-of the camera
* Experience creating and executing content calendars
* Deep understanding of social-first storytelling, internet culture, platform trends, and short-form video content. Fluent in TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including formats, trends, and what actually performs with Gen Z women
* Internet, culture, and Gen-Z fluent - knows the biggest trends, tv shows, creators, and cultural moments before they go viral
* Strong writer with a sense of humor. Experience writing engaging captions and comments; fluent in Gen Z, internet, entertainment, and pop culture across the different social platforms
* Proficient in graphic design and video editing software like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop)
* Strong communication, organizational, and creative judgment skills, with a high-ownership, hands-on approach
* Comfort partnering cross-functionally with Design, PR, and Paid Media teams
* Comfort with trackers and spreadsheets (Google Sheets) for managing multiple campaigns in parallel
* Able to prioritize and move fast when timelines shift or something breaks last-minute
* Flexibility for occasional evenings, weekends, and local travel for events and shoots

$97,000 - $110,000 a year

The salary range for this position is $97,000 - $110,000. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Los Angeles, CA. This salary will be

new_jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Associate
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Social Media and Marketing Associate to join our innovative marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing engaging content, managing social media platforms, and executing digital marketing strategies that elevate brand awareness and foster meaningful connections with our audience. Your creativity and analytical skills will drive impactful campaigns, monitor performance metrics, and ensure our brand remains vibrant across all digital channels. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a forward-thinking organization committed to growth and excellence.

**Responsibilities**

* Create compelling social media content tailored to various platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok, ensuring consistency with brand voice and messaging
* Manage daily social media activities using tools like Hootsuite or Buffer, scheduling posts, engaging with followers, and responding to comments to foster community engagement
* Develop and implement social media marketing campaigns that align with overall marketing goals and target audience interests
* Conduct social listening to monitor brand reputation, industry trends, and competitor activities, providing insights for strategic adjustments
* Utilize Adobe Creative Suite applications such as Photoshop and Illustrator for graphic design and media editing to produce eye-catching visuals
* Analyze social media performance metrics using analytics tools like Google Analytics and platform-specific insights to optimize content strategy and improve engagement rates
* Support public relations initiatives by crafting press releases, managing media relationships, and coordinating outreach efforts to enhance brand visibility
* Conduct keyword research and SEO best practices to improve content discoverability across digital channels
* Monitor digital marketing performance through detailed analytics reports, adjusting strategies based on data-driven insights

**Skills**

* Proficiency in social media platforms management including Facebook Advertising, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Campaigns, TikTok Ads, etc.
* Strong content creation skills with the ability to write engaging copy and produce multimedia content such as videos and photography
* Experience with graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and media editing software for high-quality visual production
* Knowledge of social listening tools and techniques for reputation management and trend analysis
* Familiarity with digital marketing analytics platforms including Google Analytics and web analytics tools for monitoring campaign success
* Ability to develop effective social media content marketing strategies that align with branding goals
* Excellent proofreading skills ensuring error-free content across all channels
* Strong relationship management skills for collaborating with internal teams and external partners
* Understanding of SEO principles and keyword research techniques to enhance online visibility
* Experience in public relations activities including media outreach, press release writing, and event promotion
* Ability to analyze media performance analytics and optimize campaigns for maximum impact

Join us as a Social Media and Marketing Associate if you’re passionate about storytelling through digital channels, eager to innovate in the fast-paced world of online marketing, and ready to make a tangible impact on our brand’s growth!

Pay: $17.50 - $21.00 per hour

Expected hours: 35.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
Social Media & Content Manager

**Full-Time | 40 Hours Per Week | Initial 3-Month Contract | Travel Required | Remuneration Negotiable Based on Experience**

We’re looking for a **creative, highly social-media-literate Social Media & Content Manager** to manage social media and content across two music artist projects.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands what makes great social content and knows how to turn music, personality, performances, behind-the-scenes moments, and everyday activity into content people genuinely want to watch and engage with.

You’ll work closely with the artists and management while taking ownership of the day-to-day social media and content operation across both projects — from coming up with ideas and capturing content through to editing, publishing, community management, and analyzing performance.

This role will also involve **travel with the artists when required** to capture content around performances, shoots, promotional opportunities, and other key moments.

What You’ll Be Doing

* Manage the day-to-day social media presence across two artist projects.
* Develop and execute distinct social media and content strategies for each artist.
* Create and manage content calendars across TikTok, Instagram, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other relevant platforms.
* Generate original content concepts and recurring social formats.
* Film and capture social-first content with the artists.
* Edit engaging short-form video content.
* Understand and implement strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, and retention techniques.
* Write captions and maintain a consistent and recognizable tone of voice for each project.
* Post, schedule, and optimize content across platforms.
* Identify relevant trends, memes, sounds, formats, and cultural moments — and understand which ones actually make sense for each artist.
* Turn studio sessions, rehearsals, performances, shoots, travel, releases, and everyday moments into compelling social content.
* Plan and execute social content around singles, music videos, performances, announcements, and other key moments.
* Work with longer-form and podcast content, identifying strong moments and repurposing them into effective short-form content.
* Travel with the artists when required to capture and create content around performances, shoots, promotional activity, and other key moments.
* Manage audience engagement and help build active online communities around both projects.
* Identify collaboration and cross-posting opportunities with creators, guests, and other relevant accounts.
* Monitor social performance across platforms.
* Understand metrics including watch time, retention, reach, shares, saves, engagement, and follower growth.
* Use analytics to determine what is working, what isn't, and what should be tested next.
* Test different concepts, hooks, edits, formats, and posting approaches to continually improve performance.
* Organize content, assets, deadlines, approvals, and publishing schedules across both projects.
* Communicate regularly with the artists and management around upcoming content needs, ideas, priorities, and results.
* Take ownership of the social media workflow while collaborating closely with the wider team.

What We’re Looking For

You should have a **strong instinct for social media, content, and internet culture** and genuinely enjoy figuring out why certain content works.

We’re looking for someone who:

* Has a deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
* Has strong short-form filming and editing skills.
* Understands hooks, pacing, storytelling, and audience retention.
* Has a strong creative eye and good visual instincts.
* Can consistently generate content ideas rather than waiting to be told what to make.
* Understands music, entertainment, and artist culture.
* Can recognize interesting, funny, emotional, or engaging moments that others might overlook.
* Is comfortable filming and working directly with artists.
* Understands the difference between jumping on trends and creating content that actually fits someone's identity.
* Can take a piece of long-form or podcast content and identify the moments most likely to work on social.
* Can balance creative instincts with analytics and performance data.
* Is organized and capable of managing multiple platforms and content streams simultaneously.
* Can work independently and take ownership while communicating effectively with artists and management.
* Can move quickly when an unexpected content opportunity arises.
* Is comfortable with **domestic and potentially international travel** as required.
* Is willing to experiment, learn, and adapt based on results.

**Previous experience managing social media or creating content for musicians, creators, entertainment, podcasts, or other personality-led brands is highly regarded.**

This position will begin as an **initial 3-month, full-time contract**, with an expected commitment of approximately **40 hours per week**.

At the end of the initial three-month period, there may be an opportunity to continue or extend the role based on performance, fit, and the ongoing needs of the projects.

new_jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Coordinator / Production Planner
new_jobs.description:
***About Avalon***

Avalon is a growing manufacturing technology company specializing in aerospace and defense manufacturing with CNC machining, robotics, and advanced automation. We serve aerospace, defense, and industrial customers.

*About the Role*

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Manufacturing Ops Coordinator to manage manufacturing orders from start to finish.

You'll coordinate purchasing, vendors, production schedules, outside processing, and deliveries to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.

***Your mission:*** Keep manufacturing orders moving, solve problems before they become delays, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Key Responsibilities

* **Manage Manufacturing Orders:** Track orders through every stage of production, following bills of materials (BOMs), routings, and delivery schedules.
* **Purchasing & Sourcing:** Find suppliers, obtain quotes, negotiate pricing, issue purchase orders, and track deliveries.
* **Coordinate Outside Processing:** Manage vendors for heat treating, plating, finishing, inspection, and other services.
* **Production Scheduling:** Coordinate with shop personnel to prioritize jobs, monitor progress, and resolve bottlenecks.
* **ERP Software Management:** Maintain accurate order statuses, purchasing records, and schedules in Odoo.
* **Quality Documentation:** Collect material certifications, processing certifications, and other required records.
* **On-Time Delivery:** Proactively identify delays, follow up on outstanding items, and ensure customer deadlines are met.

Required:

* We are looking for someone first and foremost with a **positive, can-do attitude** that loves working with other people (this position is mostly people-oriented). Any technical skills you don't have will be trained.
* Excellent **organizational**, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong **attention to detail**, initiative, and follow-through.
* Must be a **US citizen**

Bonus qualifications:

* 3+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, production planning, purchasing, or a related role.
* Experience with manufacturing workflows, BOMs, purchase orders, and vendor coordination.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Excel.
* Experience in CNC machining, aerospace manufacturing, or AS9100 environments
* **College degree not required.**

***Why Join Avalon?***

Join a growing, technology-driven manufacturing company at the intersection of manufacturing and robotics. You'll work directly with leadership, take ownership of meaningful responsibilities, and help shape how we scale our operations.

Pay: $58,500.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Assists with planning and manufacturing, organizes and controls the flow of production hardware to support upper-level demands and customer order requirements. Monitor and control product line MRP schedules that effectively support both customer demands and internal requirements. Accommodate and plan to customer “need” early requirements if detailed investigation yields it to be achievable.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Generate and respond to the various MRP/MPS exception-based reporting systems in a timely manner to insure due dates and priorities are properly defined for the shop floor or procurement staff.
* Utilize various tools available to review and coordinate efforts needed to support required start and completion dates of components, subs and top assemblies.
* Alert upper-level supervision when an unresolved capacity/material constraint is/will affect the company’s ability to meet a customer’s scheduled delivery requirement.
* Validate shop order packet data for accuracy and completion. Correct as needed before submitting to the shop floor.
* Notify interfacing departments to effect corrections to system data values that have resulted in invalid outputs, particularly those affecting shop load and scheduling.
* Respond and coordinate all activities associated with part drawing releases and subsequent revisions related thereto.
* Review planning- SO traveler, making sure all required items for travel are released with proper lot number for traceability.
* Prepare any special labels for shipping, per customer requirements (space items have special requirements).
* Prepare packing slips with all special space requirements (i.e. serial no., P.O. number, critical path, X-ray#)
* Follow up with manufacturing to ensure work orders are completed as scheduled.
* Comply with prescribed operating practices including those associated with QCI, MEP and SOP processes and procedures.
* Participate in production meetings, conferences, seminars and presentations as directed by immediate or department head supervision.
* Excellent communication skills in a cross functional workplace.  
  Ability to effectively organize several distinct manufacturing functions, delegate appropriately, and review the work and performance of all areas in a manner conducive to efficient performance and supportive of the company culture.
* This job description is not all inclusive of all duties. Other duties may be assigned.

  

**Education and Experience**

* High School Graduate
* APICS training, seminars and/or college courses. Vocational or national certification is preferred but not required.
* Professional related seminars, symposiums or accredited logistics management courses
* 6 months+ work related experience in Production/Inventory Control field or some experience as a PC material planner/scheduler or expeditor.
* 6 months working background within a manufacturing type environment, including some experience with an online computerized MRP or equivalent scheduling system.

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Basic analytical and sound decision making skills.
* Able to work independently with minimal direct supervision.
* Experience with computerized systems – BPCS or equivalent MRP II software, and job-related Microsoft Applications.
* Knowledge/exposure to various types of manufacturing processes and controls.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* N/A

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

To successfully perform the essential functions of this role, an individual must:

* **Work Environment Exposures:**
  + Work around equipment and machinery in a manufacturing environment.
  + Walk on uneven ground.
  + Be exposed to excessive noise, dust, gases, fumes, and chemicals commonly associated with manufacturing processes (e.g., paint, solvents, coatings, and fiberglass).
  + Be exposed to extremes in temperature, humidity, or wetness, particularly on the manufacturing floor.
* **Protective Equipment:**
  + Use special visual or auditory protective equipment as required.
  + Use safety glasses and wear safety shoes as required.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Lift, push, and pull up to 35 lbs.
* Sit, stand, and walk frequently.
* Bend, stoop, squat, reach occasionally
* Frequent use and motion of hands and arms, including gripping and grasping
* Operate computers and equipment frequently.

  

**Special Requirements**

* N/A

  

**Limitations and Disclaimer**

*This job description outlines essential responsibilities but does not represent an exhaustive list. The company may modify duties as needed. The company provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with ADA and applicable state laws.*

new_jobs.description:
**About NGY Group & Parriott Wood**

NGY Group is a kitchen and bath supplier with showrooms in Southern California, the San Francisco Bay Area, and New Jersey. Our signature cabinet brand, **Parriott Wood**, offers more than 40 custom cabinetry lines and ready-to-assemble collections such as Shaker and Elegant Shaker, alongside 50+ quartz countertop designs, sinks, faucets, and hardware. As a supplier, we partner with contractors, builders, design professionals, and retailers, and we back every order with quality products, competitive pricing, a wide selection, and hands-on design and order support. Learn more at ngyusa.com.

**Position Summary**

NGY is hiring a Purchasing Coordinator for our Santa Ana location. This role keeps our Parriott Wood cabinets, stone, and kitchen and bath products in stock by ordering from vendors, tracking shipments, and keeping purchasing records accurate. You'll communicate with vendors in English and Mandarin, compare pricing, and work closely with our warehouse and sales teams so customers get what they need on time. This role offers room to grow for someone who wants to build a long-term career in purchasing and supply chain and take on more responsibility over time.

* Monitor stock levels and identify purchasing needs based on sales and inventory data

* Coordinate with warehouse staff to make sure products arrive complete and in good condition, and help resolve damages or shortages

* Fluent English and Mandarin communication skills (written and spoken)
* Microsoft Excel skills (formulas, lookups, sorting and filtering, basic reports)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with numbers and records
* Ability to manage multiple orders, vendors, and deadlines at once
* Strong communication and follow-up skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ year of experience as a Purchasing Coordinator, Purchasing Coordinator, or in a similar role
* Understanding of supply chain, import, or logistics processes
* Experience with ERP or purchasing software (e.g., Redant ERP, Procurify, SpendMap)
* Experience in kitchen and bath, building materials, distribution, or import/export
* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field

**Physical Requirements**

* Communicating with vendors, employees, and business partners by phone, email, and in person
* Operating computers, telephones, and other business equipment
* Occasionally moving through warehouse areas to check incoming products
* Occasionally lifting or moving product samples and paperwork

**What Makes This Role Different**

This role has real room to grow. You'll learn how products move from our vendors to our customers and play a direct part in keeping our showrooms and warehouse running. new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY / OBJECTIVE**

The Account Manager is responsible for the overall ownership, growth, and execution of assigned customer accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients and is accountable for both **account performance (revenue, margin, and growth)** and **successful project delivery**.

This position builds upon the Project Manager role and **retains core project management responsibilities**, while adding full ownership of client relationships and financial performance. The Account Manager is expected to both **manage projects directly** and **oversee project execution across internal teams**, ensuring all work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Account Ownership & Growth**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, building and maintaining long-term relationships.
* Develop and execute account strategies to grow revenue and profitability.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Super Color’s product and service offerings.
* Meet or exceed assigned revenue and margin goals.
* Maintain and manage a pipeline of opportunities within existing accounts.

**Project Management & Execution (Core Responsibility)**

* Directly manage projects from quote stage through completion, maintaining full accountability for timelines, accuracy, and delivery.
* Perform all core Project Manager duties as needed, including:
* + Creating estimates and RFQs
  + Converting estimates into jobs (work orders)
  + Monitoring projects through production
  + Coordinating installations and vendors
* Act as the **final point of accountability** for all projects within assigned accounts, whether executed personally or delegated.
* Ensure all project details, specifications, and client expectations are clearly communicated and executed.

**Project Oversight & Team Coordination**

* Delegate project tasks to Project Managers or Junior Project Managers when appropriate.
* Oversee and support Project Managers to ensure consistent execution and quality.
* Conduct or participate in pre-production and RFQ meetings with Production, Estimating, and Management.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues impacting production, timelines, or client satisfaction.

**Client Management**

* Lead all client communications, including project updates, issue resolution, and strategic discussions.
* Set and manage client expectations regarding timelines, pricing, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular account reviews to ensure satisfaction and uncover growth opportunities.

**Estimating & Financial Responsibility**

* Create, review, and approve estimates and pricing strategies for assigned accounts.
* Ensure all projects meet margin and profitability targets.
* Negotiate pricing, scope, and timelines with clients as needed.
* Maintain accountability for account financial performance.

**Internal Leadership & Mentorship**

* Provide direction and guidance to Project Managers assigned to accounts.
* Assist in training and onboarding of Junior Project Managers.
* Act as a resource for escalation and problem-solving across teams.

**COMPENSATION STRUCTURE**

* Base salary + commission tied to:
* + Account revenue growth
  + Client retention and expansion

**COMPETENCIES**

* Account Management & Relationship Building
* Project Management (Execution & Oversight)
* Sales & Revenue Growth
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication Proficiency (Verbal & Written)
* Problem Solving / Decision Making
* Strong Sense of Ownership & Accountability
* Customer Service Excellence
* Financial Acumen (Margins, Pricing, Profitability)
* Operational & Production Awareness

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Indirect oversight of Project Managers and Junior Project Managers.
* Responsible for delegation and quality of work within assigned accounts.

**POSITION TYPE / EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK**

* Full-time position.
* This position requires on-site presence at Super Color Digital facilities and is not a remote role.
* Employees are expected to be in the office during standard business hours each workday to support cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Production, and Project Management teams.
* This role does not offer flexible or remote work arrangements, as consistent in-person communication is essential to successful project execution and account management.
* May require extended hours or occasional weekend work to support client deadlines and production schedules.

**EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS PREFERRED**

* 5+ years of experience in Project Management, Account Management, or related field.
* Experience in print, graphics, manufacturing, or related industry preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage both client relationships and project execution.
* Strong understanding of production workflows and estimating processes.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**KEY ROLE CLARIFICATION**

* This is **not a pure sales role**.
* This is **not a pure project management role**.
* This is a **hybrid ownership role** responsible for:
* + Client relationship
  + Revenue growth
  + Project execution

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales - Aftermarket
new_jobs.description:
**IMI plc**

We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world – creating lasting impact for everyone.

We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science, and Transport.

Our partnership approach breaks through problems and reduces complexity. We don’t invent in isolation – we collaborate with our customers. We listen closely and we think differently, creating space for diverse minds to innovate. We are working together to make businesses safer, more sustainable and more productive.

  

**Role Overview**:

The Inside Sales Representative supports existing customer accounts within the critical valve manufacturing industry by providing quotations, processing orders, and serving as a primary point of contact for customers. This role works closely with customers, the outside sales team, and internal departments to ensure accurate and timely support of customer requirements.

Following an initial training and evaluation period, the Inside Sales Representative is expected to take ownership of an assigned territory of existing customer accounts. The position carries individual sales performance expectations in addition to responsibilities for accuracy, customer service, account management, and effective follow-through.

The candidate must be detail-oriented, customer-focused, able to manage multiple priorities, and capable of working with minimal supervision after training is completed but can also adapt to working and collaborating in a team environment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills are essential for identifying customer needs, resolving issues, researching product information, and supporting accurate quotations and order processing.

  

**Work Environment**:

Lake Forrest, CA - Hybrid

* Occasional travel to local customer sites

  

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Prepare customer quotations using available pricing, product, and historical sales information.
* Process customer orders accurately and in accordance with established procedures.
* Communicate with customers through phone and email regarding quotations, orders, product information, and account-related needs.
* Coordinate with the outside sales team to support customer accounts and sales activities.
* Research cost history, engineering drawings, specifications, and product information required to quote and sell parts.
* Maintain accurate and complete records in Salesforce CRM system.
* Manage multiple customer requests, priorities, and deadlines while ensuring timely follow-through.
* Exercise sound judgment within assigned authority levels and seek guidance when appropriate.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of company products, systems, and procedures.
* Support ongoing customer satisfaction and account retention efforts within an assigned territory.

  

**Critical Competencies for Success**:

Required Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong customer service, verbal communication, and written communication skills.
* Accurate typing, data entry, and recordkeeping abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and changing workloads.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new products, systems, and processes quickly.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision after training is completed but can also adapt to working and collaborating in a team environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Microsoft Excel.

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Two to four years of valve industry experience or similar flow control products.
* Experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Previous inside sales experience.
* Experience using Salesforce CRM.
* Experience using IFS ERP.
* Completion of customer service certifications and/or formal sales training.

**Schedule and Work Arrangement**

Work Schedule

Typical work hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

  

Training and Evaluation Period

Employees are expected to work in the office five days per week for at least the first 30 days for training and evaluation purposes.  
Additional onsite training or evaluation requirements beyond the initial 30 days may be required based on business needs and individual progress.

  

Hybrid Work Arrangement

After successful completion of the initial onsite training period, employees may be eligible for a hybrid work arrangement consisting of three days per week in the office and two days per week working remotely.

  

**Pay range**: $85,000 - $105,000 annually

Within this range, individual pay is determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications relative to the job requirements. Base pay information is aligned with market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

**Bonus eligibility**: This position is also eligible for a variable incentive pay component, separate from base salary.

  

**What IMI Can Offer You**

At IMI, one of our top priorities is to create an inclusive culture of health. We strive to remove barriers to care (whether that be physical or financial) and in doing so, we offer choice for all your health and wellbeing needs.

See below for a general overview of our amazing perks and benefits:

* Multiple health plans to choose from: HMO, PPO, and High Deductible Health Plans with a low-cost share
* Best-in-class 401K plan with zero vesting and up to 6% contribution matching
* 14-week maternity leave at full pay (Adoption benefits are equivalent)
* 4-week paternity leave at full pay (Adoption benefits are equivalent)
* Employee Resource Groups that offer community and support, like our Pride Network and Network

WCI Electric – Santa Clara, CA  
Part-Time or Full-Time | 20–40 Hours Per Week  
$30–$40 Per Hour, Based on Experience

ABOUT THE POSITION

WCI Electric is a small, family-owned electrical contracting company serving the Silicon Valley area. We are currently owner-operated and looking for a dependable, highly organized person who can become the owner’s right hand by helping manage both business operations and personal responsibilities.

This is not a traditional receptionist position. The right person will help bring organization, follow-through and structure to a busy electrical contracting business while also assisting with personal scheduling, household coordination and occasional errands.

The position can range from 20 to 40 hours per week depending on the candidate’s experience, capabilities and availability. For the right person, this has the potential to develop into a long-term operations-management position as the company grows.

BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage and prioritize email, phone messages and daily follow-ups
* Schedule service calls, site visits and customer appointments
* Communicate with customers regarding scheduling and project status
* Organize information needed for estimates and invoices
* Follow up on outstanding estimates, invoices and customer approvals
* Assist with QuickBooks Online data entry and administrative tasks
* Coordinate permits, material orders, deliveries and vendor paperwork
* Track project documents, change orders, deposits and closeout items
* Organize hiring applications and schedule candidate interviews
* Assist with customer review requests and business-development outreach
* Maintain an organized list of tasks requiring the owner’s attention
* Help develop simple systems that prevent important items from being overlooked

PERSONAL AND HOUSEHOLD RESPONSIBILITIES

* Manage personal appointments, reminders and calendar items
* Coordinate household repairs, service providers and organizing projects
* Obtain and compare vendor quotes
* Handle returns, purchases and occasional local errands
* Assist with vehicle service, property maintenance and travel planning
* Organize personal documents and ongoing projects
* Help keep the owner’s business and personal priorities organized

This is not a housekeeping, childcare or caregiving position.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* Exceptionally organized, dependable and trustworthy
* Comfortable working directly with a busy small-business owner
* Able to take loosely explained information and turn it into a clear action plan
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Professional and comfortable communicating with customers, contractors and vendors
* Able to work independently and follow assignments through to completion
* Discreet with confidential business and personal information
* Comfortable adjusting priorities when urgent issues arise
* Proficient with email, calendars, Microsoft Office and basic online systems
* Experience with QuickBooks Online, construction administration, project coordination, property management or executive assistance is helpful but not required

The ideal candidate may have previous experience as an executive assistant, personal assistant, office manager, project coordinator, property-management coordinator or small-business administrator.

SCHEDULE AND LOCATION

* Flexible schedule of approximately 20–40 hours per week
* Part-time or full-time opportunity for the right candidate
* Primarily in person in Santa Clara
* Consistent weekday schedule to be agreed upon
* Some flexibility may be available after the position is established
* Occasional local errands or vendor visits
* Reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license are required
* Approved mileage for work-related errands will be reimbursed

COMPENSATION

$30–$40 per hour, depending on experience, availability and demonstrated ability.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The successful person will reduce the number of unfinished tasks, keep customers and vendors informed, ensure important follow-ups happen and help the owner remain focused on electrical work, estimating and company growth.

This position has the potential to become an important long-term role within WCI Electric.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your résumé along with a brief response to the following:

* Describe a position where you managed professional and personal responsibilities for an owner, executive or small business.
* How do you keep track of multiple assignments and ensure nothing gets forgotten?

**About us**
------------

Mintive helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. Our gateway product scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
**Dealpath is looking for a self-motivated Customer Success Manager to join our growing team in New York City or San Francisco!**

As a Senior CSM at Dealpath, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise and strategic accounts, typically 30 to 40, for firms like Blackstone, MetLife, and Nuveen. Your customers are investment professionals and executive stakeholders who rely on Dealpath to run how they deploy capital. You'll take on the most complex accounts, mentor other CSMs, and help shape how the team operates.

### **You're excited about this opportunity because you'll:**

* **Manage a book of business:** 30-40 enterprise accounts as the primary relationship holder for investment teams and C-suite stakeholders.
* **Drive adoption and value:** Define success criteria early and make sure every customer can articulate what Dealpath is doing for their business.
* **Lead QBRs and EBRs:** Data-driven business reviews that keep customers aligned and build the case for renewal.
* **Lead renewals end to end:** Build the case well before the contract date, not at the finish line.
* **Identify and grow upsell opportunities:** Grounded in a deep understanding of each customer's investment strategy.
* **Be the voice of your customers internally:** Synthesize feedback to product, engineering, and sales.
* **Develop genuine CRE expertise:** Advise customers on configuring Dealpath to their workflows and become a trusted subject matter expert.
* **Stay close to our AI roadmap:** Our customers are actively asking about AI and our CSMs are on the front lines of how it lands.

### **Qualifications:**

* **1.5+ years** as a CSM or Client Success Manager at a B2B SaaS company, direct account ownership, not a team management role
* **Proven renewal and upsell experience**, end to end, not supporting someone else's process
* **Enterprise account experience**, multi-year contracts and executive-level stakeholders
* **QBR/EBR experience**, comfortable leading data-driven business reviews
* **Clear, polished communicator**, skilled at building credibility with C-suite stakeholders including CIOs and Heads of Acquisitions
* **Excel/Google Sheets proficiency**, you'll use it regularly
* **Curiosity about AI**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in CRE tech, proptech, or adjacent financial technology (alternative investment platforms, private capital software)
* Background supporting a complex, configurable SaaS product requiring deep domain expertise
* Familiarity with the CRE acquisition process
* Salesforce experience

**The Perks & Culture:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy.
* Commuter benefits program.
* Monthly wellness reimbursement to support physical and mental well-being.
* Hybrid Work Policy, 3 days in office (Tues/Wed/Thur).
* The estimated pay range for New York City, New York candidates is $110,000-$115,000 + equity. Eligible for variable incentive compensation with a target incentive equal to 20% of OTE. OTE range: $137,500-$150,000.
* Your compensation will be based upon several factors including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and the skills assessed in Dealpath's interview process. Your actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.
* Dealpath's compensation ranges are determined by current market data, so compensation data posted on our job posts may change as new market data becomes available.
* Interviews may include AI-assisted note-taking tools in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

**About Dealpath**:

Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal.  
  
By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns.  
  
Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including: Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital.  
  
We value your voice! If you get excited about solving real business challenges and working closely with other smart folks in a winning culture — we'd love to meet you!

**Interview Process Notice**

Dealpath conducts interviews via video conference. To support our interviewers with accurate note-taking, we may use AI-assisted transcription tools during your interview sessions. By participating in the interview process, you acknowledge that interviews may be recorded or transcribed using these tools for note-taking purposes only. Transcripts are used solely for internal evaluation and are not shared outside of the hiring team.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant Business Partner III
new_jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
As an Executive Assistant Business Partner (EABP), you are a strategic operator who provides the foundation for Uber's leadership to move fast. This isn't just about scheduling; it's about navigating a high-stakes, global environment where the stakes are high and the "conference room landscape" is complex. You'll need to act with extreme urgency and precision, anticipating logistical hurdles before they impact the business and ensuring our leaders are prepared for every critical moment.  
  
Success in this role requires a mindset of ownership and resilience. You will be part of an extraordinary EA community that prides itself on excellence and "going boldly together." We are looking for a partner who thrives in ambiguity, remains steady under pressure, and is motivated by the challenge of coordinating complex, real-world movement at a global scale.  
  
This role will support our Vice President, Corporate Development.  
  
**What you'll do**

* Provide high-level, proactive partnership by mastering complex calendars, vetting competing priorities, and making recommendations to optimize your leader's most valuable resource-time.
* Navigate the intricacies of supporting leaders across different time zones and remote environments, managing the logistics of international travel and visa processing with zero room for error.
* Unblock leadership by driving accountability for project deadlines and deliverables, taking ownership of action items to ensure the team stays on track in a fast-paced environment.
* Lead the seamless execution of high-impact events, from summits and QBRs to team all-hands, balancing operational precision with team morale.
* Manage complex financial tasks, including leader morale budgets and expense auditing, while handling sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion.
* Champion the administrative program within your organization by assisting with alignment, coverage, and hiring to ensure the team maintains its high talent bar.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional administrative experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Calendar, Mail, Docs, Sheets).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10+ years of administrative experience, with at least 6 years supporting VP-level leaders in a global or matrixed business environment.
* Proven track record of implementing systems and processes to optimize leadership efficiency and long-term business objectives.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build and maintain strategic relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience owning complex, end-to-end projects from inception to completion with minimal oversight.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate extreme ambiguity and pivot instantly to respond to shifting priorities in a high-pressure environment.

  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base hourly rate range for this role is USD $59.62 per hour - USD $66.35 per hour.  
  
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

**Description**

The Assistant Community (Property) Manager assists the Community Manager in the successful site management of the apartment community providing the necessary leadership, guidance and motivation to ensure a positive working environment and quality community living. The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for administering the day-to-day leasing office operations and is responsible for overseeing all computer input of the apartment community. The Assistant Community Manager directs the leasing staff, and works with the Community Manager to recommend marketing and leasing strategies designed to meet the goals of Shea Properties. The pay range for this position is $31.90 - $37.05/hour and the Assistant Community Manager is also eligible to participate in the office Sales Bonus, Club Shea Program and the discretionary annual bonus plan. JF Shea offers a competitive benefits package including PTO, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, 401K, disability, life insurance, discounted apartment (based on availability), and cell phone allowance.

* Prepares work orders and submits for approval in Go Cart.
* Assists in the development, preparation and administration of the capital and operating budgets for the property.

* Oversee and/or conduct weekly sales “leasing fundamentals” meetings, sign and submit fundamentals to Regional Manager for review.
* Supports industry networking and encourages direct reports to participate in industry association functions.
* Performs other duties as assigned. Actual job duties and responsibilities may vary depending on the size of the community.
* Handle on-call duties, as directed by supervisor.

* Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to give clear direction and respond to inquiries.Must be able to speak effectively before groups of customers or associates of the organization.
* Understanding of accounting principles and budget process. Ability to read and interpret numerical information. Basic understanding of the budgeting process.
* Basic understanding of marketing concepts; analyzing data; and report writing.
* Customer service experience required in at least one of the following industries: property management, hospitality, retail, and real estate.
* Negotiate and resolve conflicts.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (Word/Excel/Outlook) and Yardi & Yieldstar preferred.
* Prior experience in managing a staff (supervise, train, coach, develop, motivate, interview, hire, terminate) and lead by example.
* High School Diploma or equivalent. Some college level courses preferred.

new_jobs.title: Event Operations Specialist, North America
new_jobs.description:
Know where you belong!  
  
Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.

  

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

Match Group is seeking a highly organized and proactive Event Operations Specialist to support the planning, coordination, and execution of in-office events and experiences across our North America offices. This role sits within our Corporate Events team and partners closely with Workplace Experience (WEX) to bring memorable, well-run programs to life for employees across the company.

### **How You'll Make an Impact**

* Assist the Events Team planning and executing internal and external projects, corporate events and employee activations
* Oversee logistics for on-site event setup and support
* Provide administrative support, including contracts, Certificates of Insurance (COIs), and expenses
* Partner with the team to coordinate and facilitate facility requests and office repairs when needed
* Maintain and distribute MG event calendars company-wide
* Assist with budget tracking for events and projects
* Assist with the swag program, including placing orders, design assistance and inventory
* Source and onboard new vendors and event venues
* Partner with Security, HR, Facilities, and the Corporate Events, WEX teams to initiate and maintain company-wide policies
* Occasional travel required for events and project support
* Work hours may vary on event needs, occasionally nights and weekends
* Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 30 pounds without assistance
* Perform other reasonable job duties as requested

### **We could be a Match if:**

* Prior experience in event coordination, workplace experience, or corporate event operations
* Strong organizational skills and can manage multiple projects and vendors simultaneously
* Experience with administrative processes such as contracts, COIs, and expense management
* Ability to be a great team player and can also work independently
* Budget tracking or basic financial acumen and are comfortable managing spend
* Strong communication and relationship-management skills, and enjoy partnering across teams like HR, Security, and Facilities
* A detail-oriented, resourceful mindset that thrives when solving tricky problems.
* Proven ability to navigate fast-paced, high-touch environments with ease.

$75,000 - $90,000 a year

*Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of New York, NY**. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.*

#LI-LH1

**Why Match Group?**

Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:

***Mind & Body***– Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well-being

***Financial Wellness***– Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security

***Unplug*** – Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
new_jobs.description:
About Torch Dental

Torch Dental is a high-growth, venture-backed vertical SaaS company transforming how dental practices run their businesses. Our mission is to give every dental office the modern software, automation, and visibility they need to operate efficiently and profitably.

We are launching our second product in 2026 and will be expanding into the broader practice-operations layers such as Revenue Cycle Management, Finance, HR, payroll, benefits, and back-office workflows—building toward a full dental practice operating system.

Torch Dental is at the Series B stage with strong revenue growth, rapidly expanding products, and a profitable core business. As an RCM Customer Success Manager you’ll play a critical role in shaping the customer experience for our AI-powered revenue cycle management product, partnering closely with dental practices to drive successful adoption, deliver measurable outcomes and help build the foundation for how we scale RCM Customer Success.

About the role

Torch Revenue Cycle Management is Torch Dental's second product: an AI-enabled revenue cycle management platform that helps dental practices. We're launching the product to single practices, multi-location groups and emerging DSOs. We're hiring our first dedicated Customer Success Manager for this product to own the customer relationship end-to-end: from kickoff and payer/PMS setup, through go-live, through ongoing retention and expansion.

What you'll do

* Own onboarding for new RCM customers: lead kickoff calls, and guide practices through going live and continuing to engage with the platform.
* Be the primary point of contact for a growing book of RCM accounts — spanning solo practices, groups, and emerging DSOs — through go-live, steady-state usage, and renewal.
* Be the customer's advocate internally: feed structured feedback to Product and Engineering on integration issues, payer coverage gaps, and workflow pain points, and to Sales on expansion and DSO opportunities.
* Help build the playbook: since this is a new, high-touch, fast-scaling function, you'll help define onboarding scripts, health-score criteria, and escalation processes as much as execute them.
* Partner closely with the RCM sales, product, and billing-ops team during the handoff from sales-closed to customer-live, and take that ownership off their plates.
* Handle the compliance-sensitive parts of onboarding correctly — BAAs, PMS credentials, payer portal access — in a HIPAA-aware way.

What we're looking for

**Required:**

* 3–5+ years in a customer success, account management, or implementation role, ideally in a startup or fast-scaling SaaS environment.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: this is a first-of-its-kind role at Torch, without an existing playbook, on a product that is itself still early and evolving.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be explaining claims and billing concepts to dental office staff and translating customer workflows back to engineering and product.
* Strong tech competency - you will be working directly with customers on integrating several solutions and will need to do basic tech implementation. You should feel comfortable with tech and learning new solutions.
* Process-builder mindset: comfortable creating and iterating on onboarding scripts, health-score frameworks, and escalation paths rather than inheriting a mature one.
* Familiarity with dental practice management systems (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, or similar) is a strong plus; comfort learning new PMS and payer systems quickly is required.

**Nice to have:**

* Background as a dental or medical biller, RCM specialist, or practice manager.
* Direct, hands-on experience with dental or medical billing / revenue cycle workflows — you know what an EOB, ERA, clearinghouse, and payer portal are, and ideally have touched claims submission or payment posting yourself.
* Experience supporting healthcare or dental customers through a HIPAA-regulated onboarding process (BAAs, PHI handling).
* Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM for account and health tracking.
* Experience working with DSOs (dental support organizations) or multi-location group practices.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at PowerPlan, you will manage the relationship of a portfolio of energy and utility customers, serving as their trusted advisor from renewal to expansion. You will partner with Sales and the extended account team to help each customer get measurable ROI from their PowerPlan solutions, working proactively to keep your accounts healthy, surface opportunities and address risk before it becomes churn, and grow ARR year over year.

You will work at every level of a customer's organization, building trusted relationships and staying connected across the account, including leading quarterly business reviews to senior leadership. This is a relationship-driven, customer-facing role where retention, advocacy, and growth are yours to drive.

PowerPlan is the leading tax and accounting software for asset-intensive businesses, improving financial outcomes through AI-powered technology that enables companies to overcome their most complex financial challenges. Our enterprise-grade tax, accounting, reporting, and workflow automation software serves the office of the CFO at some of the world's largest asset-intensive companies, helping them generate more cashflow, mitigate compliance risk, and build a culture of cost management.

Our Customer Success organization is where that promise is kept after the sale: the team that turns PowerPlan's capabilities into renewals, references, and long-term value for our customers.

Responsibilities:

* Own the renewal and forecast outcome for your assigned book of business, understanding each account's contractual terms, pricing strategy, and services history to track ARR, churn risk, and bringing accurate status into the monthly Renewal and Risk Meeting.
* Become a trusted advisor by building multithreaded relationships across each account, removing roadblocks and demonstrating a clear return on their PowerPlan investment.
* Build industry acumen in Energy, Utilities, and other asset-intensive industries, and maintain functional knowledge of the PowerPlan solution, understanding what drives customer success, speaking credibly to product capabilities, and knowing each customer's product footprint and usage, so you can anticipate needs and guide accounts toward the outcomes that matter most to them.
* Maintain strong customer sentiment and account engagement through proactive relationship management, accurate health scoring in Salesforce and Planhat, early risk identification, and save plans that drive net-positive red-to-green movement each quarter.
* Lead standardized Quarterly Business Reviews that connect PowerPlan capabilities to customer business objectives, demonstrate value through utilization and outcome metrics, identify opportunities to increase adoption, and align on desired outcomes, agreed-upon next steps, and a path to long-term value realization.
* Manage the NPS survey for your customers, driving survey participation, closing the loop on feedback with each respondent, and helping the team reach its best-in-class score and response-rate targets.
* Represent the voice of the customer, translating feedback, business needs, and product usage trends into actionable insights for Product and Marketing to improve customer outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to year-over-year growth by identifying expansion opportunities, generating qualified leads for Sales, and developing referenceable customers.
* Advocate for your customer needs cross-functionally, coordinating with Sales, Support and Professional Services to resolve escalations, define action plans and achieve account objectives.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Account Management, Enterprise Software, SaaS, Professional Services, or a related field.
* Proven success managing a portfolio of customer relationships with accountability for customer retention, renewal outcomes, adoption, and growth opportunities.
* Experience building trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders at every level, from senior leadership to day-to-day users.
* Experience using Salesforce, Gainsight, Planhat, or a comparable Customer Success platform strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and proactively drive customer outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and meeting facilitation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels within customer organizations and internally across cross-functional teams.
* Experience leading customer business reviews, developing success plans, and driving customer engagement initiatives that deliver measurable business value.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate complex customer environments, and coordinate efforts across Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support, and other internal teams.
* Familiarity with AI-driven technologies and customer-facing software solutions is a plus, as PowerPlan continues to expand AI-powered capabilities across the NXT SaaS platform.
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and energized by working both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Willingness to travel to support customer engagements, business reviews, onsite meetings, and strategic account planning.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

**PowerPlan is an EOE**
